title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཀི (Derge Tengyur, vol. 110)
shelf_note: Canonical Tibetan Madhyamaka treatise from the Derge Tengyur volume ki (vol. 110), citing the Vimalakīrtinirdeśa.

ocr_errors.problem: extraneous hash marks inserted at several word boundaries
initial head ornament omitted from transcription

tr_errors_B.english: many thousands of living beings came from the great city, including kings...
tr_errors_B.problem: misinterprets 'other than those' (de ma yin pa) as an encompassing category containing the listed dignitaries
translates as 'unbearable' rather than 'frail / unable to withstand anything' in the foam simile

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A correctly identifies the city of Vaiśālī, accurately renders the exclusionary phrasing for the visiting crowd, and translates the body similes with superior precision.

book_verdict: An authentic folio from the Derge Tengyur Madhyamaka section citing the Vimalakīrtinirdeśa, accurately transcribed and translated without structural or copyright defects.
